workflow.critical: Execute ALL steps in exact order

step.goal: Verify project.config.json exists and is valid JSON

check.output: ❌ project.config.json not found. Run /aiqa-analyzeproject first to generate this file.

step.action: Attempt to parse as JSON — if parsing fails, this is an immediate CRITICAL failure; record it and STOP with the error details

step.goal: Run all quality checks and collect issues
step.action: Run EVERY check below. For each FAILED check: record { id, severity, description, found_value }.
step.check: project.config.json is valid, parseable JSON — FAIL if malformed
frontend field is a real framework name (Angular/React/Vue/Next.js/Nuxt/Blazor/etc.) — NOT null, "unknown", or blank
backend.framework is populated AND backend.baseUrl is a real non-placeholder URL (e.g. not "http://localhost" without a port that's confirmed correct)
routes.pages contains at least one real route entry — NOT an empty array []
database field is populated — if no DB detected, value is explicitly "none", NOT blank or null
auth.scheme is one of: jwt / oauth / session / basic / none — NOT blank
No field contains "unknown", "detected", "N/A", "TODO", or is left empty string ""

step.goal: Present validation report and ask how to proceed

check.output:
✅ Validation Passed — /aiqa-analyzeproject
All 7 quality checks passed. project.config.json is complete and accurate. No issues found — safe to proceed to /aiqa-analyzestory.

step.output:
╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗ ║ 🔍 Validation Report — /aiqa-analyzeproject ║ ╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝
File: AI-QA-FRAMEWORK/core/project.config.json
🔴 Critical ({critical_count}): (for each Critical issue: " • {id} — {description}" and " Found: {found_value}") (if none: " None")
🟠 High ({high_count}): (for each High issue: " • {id} — {description}" and " Found: {found_value}") (if none: " None")
🟡 Medium ({medium_count}): (for each Medium issue: " • {id} — {description}") (if none: " None")
🔵 Low ({low_count}): (for each Low issue: " • {id} — {description}") (if none: " None")
Total issues: {total_issues}
step.ask: How would you like to proceed? A) Fix ALL {total_issues} issue(s) — resolve every finding B) Fix only Critical + High ({critical_count + high_count} issue(s)) — skip Medium and Low C) Skip — keep the report, apply no fixes

check.output: ⏭️ No fixes applied. Issues remain in project.config.json.

step.action: For each issue selected for fixing, apply the specific fix: PC-1 → re-run: node {project-root}/AI-QA-FRAMEWORK/core/orchestrator.mjs analyze-project to regenerate the file PC-2 → re-scan package.json dependencies and src/ entry files; identify and set the correct frontend framework name PC-3 → ask user: "What is your backend base URL? (e.g. http://localhost:3000 or https://api.yourapp.com)" then update backend.baseUrl PC-4 → if no DB found: set database = "none"; if DB exists but unknown: ask user "What database does this project use?" PC-5 → ask user: "What authentication scheme does this project use? (jwt / oauth / session / basic / none)" then update auth.scheme PC-6 → read router config files: search for app-routing.module.ts, routes.js, App.tsx, router/index.js — extract all page routes; update routes.pages PC-7 → for each field containing "unknown"/"N/A"/"TODO"/"": either derive the value from project files or ask the user for the correct value; update config
Write the updated content back to project.config.json

step.goal: Re-verify fixed checks and report final status
step.action: Re-run ONLY the checks that were targeted for fixing
Classify each as: ✅ Fixed | ❌ Still failing
step.output:
📋 Validation Summary — /aiqa-analyzeproject
(for each fixed check:) ✅ {id} — resolved: {what was corrected} (for each still failing:) ❌ {id} — still failing: {reason} (for each skipped check:) ⏭️ {id} — skipped (not in selected fix scope)
(if all targeted checks pass:) ✅ All targeted issues resolved. Safe to proceed to /aiqa-analyzestory.
(if some still fail:) ⚠️ {remaining} issue(s) could not be fixed automatically. Please correct project.config.json manually, then re-run /aiqa-analyzeproject-validate.
